privateArtifact.format: Actual delivered HTML with embedded-data canonical JSON; no synthetic envelope.

notes: All 20 source JPEGs are byte-identical to the original ZIP. All 74 crops decode to identical RGB pixels in their source rectangles. Screen-only polygons exclude adjacent material without editing stored pixels.
Body, headings and captions are first-pass visual transcriptions from the source; independent all-character proofreading is not complete.

A landscape heading ink-overhang found at 844x390/font16 was fixed with a four-pixel text-height clearance. The final exact artifact passed 36 offline Chromium conditions and 21 UI checks. Initial failure evidence is retained privately.

Six checks execute the actual import validator using Node WebCrypto/Blob with DOM stubs. This does not test browser persistence or iframe integration. An intercepted synthetic HTTPS test was blocked by browser administrator policy and remains incomplete.
All 60 formal content certification checks remain not_run. Mechanical tests do not certify proofreading, real iPhone gestures, or live public URL display.
Public files contain only the import shell and audit metadata. Private book text and original/cropped images stay on Drive and device.
